settle: A larger sample (all foundation starts 2014-2023, not only the December-June windows), the flood zone at the date of the permit rather than the current PLUTO flag, and a control for project size (proposed units or floor area).

notes: Crude rates: flood 0.342, other 0.391. By borough (flood vs other): BK 0.455 (n 121) vs 0.403 (n 997); BX 0.316 (n 19) vs 0.354 (n 390); MN 0.833 (n 30) vs 0.538 (n 195); QN 0.212 (n 198) vs 0.413 (n 1098); SI 0.273 (n 33) vs 0.133 (n 195). The pooled difference is driven by Queens, where 198 floodplain starts finished faster than other Queens starts; in Brooklyn and Manhattan the floodplain starts finished more slowly. The outcome measure (job number or BBL matching) was fixed after the result of stalled-421a-vesting-footings and before this claim was registered.
notes_referee: Referee estimate with job-number matching: -0.001 (-0.051 to +0.049). Verdict unsettled stands. Registered lot matching credited neighbours' certificates on shared Rockaway lots (Queens blocks 16340, 16350).
